verdict.rationale: Pika documents generating clips from a written premise or description, from short clips up to 30-second multi-shot films. It also documents several tools for iterating on an existing clip without regenerating it from scratch: extending it, continuing from its final frame, inpainting or adding elements with a prompt, swapping objects, and reshooting from new angles. Missing for 10: an explicit plain text-prompt-to-clip workflow description (evidence is marketing-level), any documented prompt-revision or version history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time
